answer: Distance is the receipt. A key exposes an endpoint; three vantage points time a nonce trip against light-speed bounds, and it claims one routable /24 and one ASN no other key shares. Duplicates on one host return identical timings from one prefix, so the check collapses them before collateral posts. Ten thousand clones need ten thousand prefixes at $200 monthly plus a thousand ASNs at $600 setup: about $2.6 million before one answer lands. A missed window voids the bond. Picture an atlas of islands at true coordinates: a mesa that looks solid but is hollow with copies fails the survey.
